description:
# fyndling-mcp

Built for **medieval market fans, reenactors, and living-history enthusiasts** — and the AI assistants that help them plan. Fyndling MCP gives AI clients direct access to two niche European datasets:

- **Medieval events** — query 2,000+ markets, concerts, castle experiences, and living-history events across 20 European countries by **location + radius + date range** (updated weekly)
- **Permanent POIs** — meaderies, mead producers, castles, and medieval restaurants, also searchable by geo-radius
- **Historical recipes** — 1,100+ recipes from six cookbooks spanning the 13th–17th century, with modern German adaptations, structured ingredient lists, and original manuscript transcripts

→ **[fyndling.de](https://fyndling.de)** — the web app behind this data

**Endpoint:** `https://fyndling.de/mcp`  
**Transport:** Streamable HTTP (MCP spec 2025-03-26)  
**Auth:** none  
**Rate limit:** 60 requests / minute

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.description: tool declares exec permission
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: Scope Mismatch
findings.description: tool name "find_events_near" implies read-only operation but declares exec permission
findings.recommendation: Ensure tool names, descriptions, and permission declarations are internally consistent. Use explicit naming conventions that fully reflect actual capabilities.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.

findings.title: DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE
findings.description: Tool did not expose metadata.dependencies or repo_url, so supply-chain coverage is limited.
findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.
